items.description: On November 21, 1963, India launched its first sounding rocket from Thumba, establishing its space program. The rocket, Nike-Apache, carried instruments for atmospheric studies and marked a major milestone. Following this, the Indian Space Research Organisation was formed in 1969 and developed indigenous rockets.

US government bonds rallied as investors shifted away from riskier assets, causing yields to drop.
